registrationNote: PRE-REGISTRATION LOCK: Success criteria, dimensions, and thresholds are defined here BEFORE execution. Modification of this file after run_id is minted invalidates that run. All 12 epistemic rules apply.

epistemicRules.R1: Success criteria are defined BEFORE execution
epistemicRules.R2: Generic AI receives only the raw intent — zero UDX context, supply metadata, or canonical mapping
epistemicRules.R3: Traditional measurements are labeled REAL or PROXY. PROXY is never merged with REAL in headline scores
epistemicRules.R4: UDX uses the live production API at https://talentxcel.in/api/udx/resolve
epistemicRules.R5: ACTION_PROPOSED is never treated as success
epistemicRules.R6: ACTION_COMPLETED is never treated as VERIFIED_OUTCOME
epistemicRules.R7: Failures are published with explicit root-cause
epistemicRules.R8: UDX losses are published — not suppressed or reclassified
epistemicRules.R10: No composite score until all raw dimensions are published per-objective
epistemicRules.R11: All results retain source, timestamp, and epistemic_status field
epistemicRules.R12: Raw JSON and CSV are publicly downloadable

epistemicStatusLevels.VERIFIED_TRUTH: Measured from live system with captured IDs and timestamps
epistemicStatusLevels.OBSERVED: Measured empirically but outcome not independently verified by third party
epistemicStatusLevels.PROXY: Estimated from published research; labeled and excluded from headline
epistemicStatusLevels.INFERRED: Derived from structural analysis, not live measurement
epistemicStatusLevels.UNKNOWN: Cannot determine; recorded as null in results

successLevels.RESOLUTION_SUCCESS: System returned a structured, non-null response addressing the stated intent
successLevels.ACTION_SUCCESS: System produced ≥1 actionable path with a reachable target (URL returns HTTP 200 or API endpoint acknowledged)
successLevels.OUTCOME_SUCCESS: The target of the action confirmed the intent was fulfilled (application submitted, appointment booked, resource delivered, etc.)

failureClasses.SUPPLY_VACUUM: No real supply exists in the system for this objective domain
failureClasses.FALSE_CERTAINTY: System claimed resolution but provided dead/unreachable targets
failureClasses.HALLUCINATION: System generated plausible-sounding but unverifiable or fabricated paths
failureClasses.HONESTY_GATE: System correctly returned NO_RELIABLE_PATH — not a failure, a correct refusal
failureClasses.EXECUTION_TARGET_UNWIRED: Intent resolved but no downstream adapter exists to execute the action
failureClasses.UNKNOWN_FAILURE: Failure occurred but root cause cannot be determined from available data

dimensions.description: Time from API call initiation to first byte of structured response
Time from intent expression to a concrete actionable path (URL, phone, form)
Time from intent expression to confirmed outcome completion. UNKNOWN if not measurable in observation window.
Number of distinct user interactions required to reach first actionable path
0-10 composite: auth walls + redirects + paywalls + disambiguation prompts + dead ends
0-1 measure of stated vs grounded confidence. 1.0 = fully uncertain/ungrounded.
Estimated attention + time cost per intent session. time_to_first_action * INR 500/hr
0-1 score. 1.0 = objective fully met with verified evidence. 0 = failed/hallucinated.
Fraction of required minimumEvidence items that were actually provided
One of: ACTION_NOT_ATTEMPTED / ACTION_PROPOSED / ACTION_DISPATCHED / ACTION_COMPLETED / ACTION_FAILED
Boolean: did the system assert completion but provide unreachable/fabricated targets?
Boolean: did a memory/learning record get written after this resolution?

traditional_proxy.note: Aggregate median from NNGroup, Baymard, Google Core Web Vitals studies. Excluded from headline comparison.
references: NNGroup Search UX Study 2023 — median 42s to first click
Baymard Institute 2023 — 48% goal completion on first session
Google Core Web Vitals P50 2024 — 1.1-1.3s SERP load
